quotes.text: Wars are proclaimed by the elders, yet it is the young who bear the burden of fighting and dying.
No country can claim liberty if it denies it to others.
A man without a sense of history is like one without ears or eyes.
Truth is the earliest victim of war.
The most formidable opponent of any combinist government is a person capable of independent thought.
I may disagree with your words, but I will fight to protect your right to speak them.
All alliances are temporary; all mistrust is eternal.
